newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-SPAIN'S MOYA OUSTS SWEDE BJORKMAN IN OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SPAIN'S MOYA OUSTS SWEDE BJORKMAN IN OPEN.

text.p: Spain's Carlos Moya produced yet more stunning baseline tennis on Sunday to oust fellow non-seed Jonas Bjorkman of Sweden and earn a place in the quarter-finals of the Australian Open.

The 20-year-old, who bundled German defending champion Boris Becker out of the tournament in the first round, took an early lead but fell two sets to one down as serve-and-volley specialist Bjorkman came forward to dominate from the net.
Helped by a steadily-improving serve, Moya rallied to win the match 6-3 1-6 3-6 6-2 6-4 with a succession of unreturnable backhands and forehands.
He served 10 aces in a match lasting two hours and 27 minutes.
Moya, one of three Spanish men who started the fourth round, will meet either compatriot Felix Mantilla, the men's 14th seed, or American MaliVai Washington in the quarter-finals.
